title: With all three permissions a custom role can move customers
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A}, on a custom role, {Role-A}, that has Settings → Finance, Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data (and whatever it needs to reach Settings), and nothing else that matters here.
    For example: {User-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-29 User and {Role-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-29 Role.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 20 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly one customer, {Customer-A}.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-29 N20, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-29 Solo.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 45" in "Move To".
  4. Click "Move 1 Customer".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens.
  • Step 3: the button is enabled.
  • Step 4: the toast "1 customer moved to Net 45." shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “Move Customers additionally needs 'Customers → Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', because it changes customer records;”
  • Key Decisions: “Departure: Move Customers keeps a gate from another area on a Settings page. It needs 'Customers → Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' as well as 'Settings → Finance'.”
  • S4-R9: “On confirm, each ticked customer's credit term changes to the chosen term, the window closes, the page's Customers counts update, and a success toast shows "{n} customers moved to {term}." ("1 customer moved to {term}." for one).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf): canvas pages "2 Move customers to another term" (the pages the PRD names for this story). The design (read in full on 23 Oct 2026) does not draw this case's screen or state, so no design picture is attached; the expected results above come from the PRD.
